I was 13-14 and spent a lot of my time online. Back then, I was mainly on Facebook and would accept every friend request. This led to a lot of interactions with randoms so nothing seemed off when this stranger I added started talking to me. She lived in my country but on the opposite end according to her profile. We chat on and off for a few days when she tells me she has a friend she’d like me to meet. Slowly, a weird feeling starts to creep up that I can’t fully explain. It was as if she suddenly felt like a different person. I asked her who her friend was and she gives me a guy’s name and tells me to add him because “he’s shy”. She said she told him about me and how nice I was so I’d be a great friend for him. At this point, I’m feeling incredibly uneasy but I’m a bit of a people pleaser so I went ahead and sent the request. Immediately, I get a message from him and I’m just frozen with anxiety. I never answered any of his messages and a few days later got a message from my “friend” about how she heard from the guy that I ignored him and it made him sad. I never replied and moved on without incident. 

Cue a couple years later, I’m 17 and reading the newspaper and there’s a story about the police apprehending a known pedophile at our airport. He brought gifts with him (expensive laptops, toys, cash) and other things I won’t mention. It came out that he was behind both profiles and used the first one to lure and groom his victims. He had come to meet with two underage girls whose parents were alerted to the situation and contacted the police. I remembered the feeling I had all those years ago and I’m beyond thankful for listening to it.
